items.title: Was Pochito’s in Houston Worth the Hype? 🌮👀
items.description:
We were staying nearby in Houston and wanted to try somewhere new, so we checked Google Maps for highly rated spots and came across Pochitos Mariscos y Más! 👀🦐

They specialize in Mexican seafood, with everything from seafood platters and aguachiles to ceviche and Mexican-inspired sushi. 🌮🍣 The ratings caught our attention, so we decided to see what it was all about!

What other Houston restaurants should we check out next time we're in town?

#FoodicanAdventures #Pochitos #MexicanSeafood #HoustonFood
